caption: A boy catches a ball thrown to him with both hands and holds on to it.

sa.check: A ball is thrown to a boy.
He catches it with both hands.
The throw comes first and the catch follows.

pc.expect: The ball stops in his hands and does not pass through them.
pc.fail: It passes through his hands; or passes into his chest; or his hands close on nothing while the ball goes on.

pc.expect: His arms reach, his hands close, his arms give slightly as it arrives, and the joints bend.
pc.fail: His arms stretch like rubber; or his hands detach; or his arms bend mid-forearm.

pc.expect: The ball travels in an arc to him and stops at the catch.
pc.fail: It changes direction in mid-air; or stops in the air before his hands; or keeps going after the catch.

pc.expect: He stays on his feet and the ball's arc dips.
pc.fail: He floats; or the ball curves upward; or the ball hangs.

pc.expect: His limbs keep their number and stay attached, and one ball stays one ball.
pc.fail: A limb detaches; or the ball duplicates; or he merges with the ball.

pc.expect: His clothing and the ball stay the same.
pc.fail: His clothing changes colour; or the ball changes; or the background rearranges.

note: Biomechanics scene: the body is the physics. Gait, posture, style and skill are not judged; only that limbs stay attached, bend at joints, keep ground contact and pass through nothing.
